Bihar Election Result LIVE:
The vote counting for the Bihar elections has begun. Who is leading in the early trends? Is the Nitish Kumar–led NDA returning to power, or will the Tejashwi Yadav–led Mahagathbandhan make it this time?
The Khabargaon team has covered more than 100 seats and has been on the ground for over 100 days. What our reporters witnessed, what voters told us, and which factors are shaping the Bihar election results — watch Khabargaon for detailed analysis and the latest updates.
